description: This source file defines a static utility class `TestConfig` in the `OrangeHrm.UiTests.Support` namespace. The class loads environment variables from a `.env` file if present, and provides static methods to retrieve configuration settings such as URLs, browser type, headless mode, and login credentials, with support for overrides through NUnit test parameters, environment variables, and defaults.
